observations.title: Reventador volcano (Ecuador)
observations.description: The Instituto Geofísico-Escuela Politécnica Nacional (IG-EPN) reported that eruptive activity at Reventador continued at a high level during 4-11 November. Seismicity included 63-89 daily explosions, long-period earthquakes, harmonic tremor, and tremor associated with emissions. Daily ash-and-gas plumes were visible in webcam images and reported by the Washington Volcanic Ash Advisory Center rising as high as 1.5 km above the crater rim and drifting in multiple directions. Incandescent blocks were visible during dark hours each day rolling as far as 1.1 km down the flanks. A pyroclastic flow descended the S flank on 18 October. The Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos (SGR) maintained the Alert Level at Orange (the second highest level on a four-color scale). Sources: Instituto Geofísico-Escuela Politécnica Nacional (IG-EPN) ,Secretaría de Gestión de Riesgos (SGR)
